_about: g26b with beats at sentence ends (2026-10-26). With the voice anchor in the app, the model's own turn-taking became audible: it hands over after nearly every sentence and comes back only as a nudge seconds later, because in the written calls the caller speaks next after 97% of the friend's sentence ends (real calls: the speaker carries on 90% of the time). Here 30% of the friend's sentence ends get a beat of one tick (93%) or two, tagged speak_pause, and it carries on (speak_on, weight 3); the other 70% run straight on, as on the recorded calls. The calls change, so the cache is new (~53 GB). Otherwise g26b. Side effect: chunks follow sentences, so a sentence's last chunk is often short: 2.68 words a speaking tick instead of 2.89 (real people 2.05), one-word ticks 10% instead of 4%.
name: g26b2
